lesson-intro.text: Remember the apple, the pear, the banana and the grapes? They're all back, sharing one big blue bowl. See who sits in front, then fill a bowl of your own.

rim-pear.text: Start with the bowl's front edge, one long curve. The pear sits on it: two sides and a stem.

apple.text: The apple leans against the pear. Round up each side, dip at the top, and add its stem.

leaf.text: A leaf sticks out to the left of the apple's stem. Out and back, then a line through it.

grapes.text: The grapes squeeze in on the right. Draw five round curves, each tucked behind the last.

grape-stem.text: Give the grapes a stem that curls up to the right, and close the little gap.

banana.text: The banana lies along the back. Go up from the leaf, over the top, and cap both ends.

banana-lines.text: Fill in the bits of banana you can see between the fruit, then three long lines along it.

bowl.text: Now finish the bowl: the back rim, the round sides and a little foot. Add a short curve by the grapes.

blue.text: Color the bowl blue, darker on the inside.

red-green.text: Color the apple red and the pear light green.

yellow-purple.text: The banana is yellow and the grapes are purple.

last-bits.text: Stems and banana ends are brown, the leaf green. Add a gray shadow under the bowl.

lesson-outro.text: Apple, pear, banana and grapes, all in one bowl you drew. That's the Fruits path done. Anyone hungry?
